---
title: "Unemployment by region"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tinytable)
change <- read_csv("unemployment.csv") |>
  filter(region != "Kingdom") |>
  group_by(region) |>
  summarise(first = first(rate),
            last = last(rate))
```

```{r}
change |>
  tt() |>
  theme_html(portable = TRUE)
```
